rules: Every entry MUST carry a written `reason` — who measured it, against what reference, and why the overlap is intentional or a measured seat (no bare suppressions).
An allowlist entry without a reason is ignored by the gate.
Viewport-edge crossings can NOT be allowlisted — they always fail.
Prune entries at every cycle close: anything fixed should leave this file.
